articleTitle: Application of deep learning technology in intelligent decision support and risk warning of information management system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the design of intelligent decision support and risk warning system of information management system based on deep learning technology. By using the methods of deep learning, data mining, risk assessment and intelligent decision support, an innovative deep learning technology is proposed in the application of intelligent decision support and risk early warning of information management system, aiming at improving the intelligent decision ability and risk early warning ability of information management system. The deep learning method is used to train the deep learning model to learn a large amount of data in order to realize intelligent decision support and risk warning for the information management system. Data mining method is used to find potential risk factors and decision support information by analyzing the correlation between data. The risk assessment method is used to assess and predict the potential risks facing the system. Finally, intelligent decision support method is used to provide personalized decision support and risk warning information for users.

articleTitle: Development of Xi'an Tourism Data Prediction Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This study takes Xi'an tourism as the research object, constructs a tourism data prediction model based on machine learning technology, and proposes a complete prediction framework by analyzing the core factors affecting the development of tourism, including the number of tourists, hotel occupancy rate, traffic flow, weather conditions and promotional activities. The study uses three models of support vector regression, random forest and deep neural network for comparative analysis. The results show that deep neural network has significant advantages in prediction accuracy and stability. In the process of model optimization, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning and distributed computing technology are introduced to significantly improve the operation efficiency and prediction performance of the model. This study provides an effective tool for the scientific planning and refined management of the tourism industry, and also demonstrates the application potential of machine learning in complex nonlinear problems.

articleTitle: A Study of Attention-Based YOLOv5 for Forest Fire Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Fire detection is crucial for safeguarding lives and property. The development of deep learning technology has enabled significant potential in fire detection methods based on image and video analysis. The study proposes an improved fire detection algorithm based on YOLOv5 by incorporating a Coordinate Attention (CA) mechanism to enhance model performance. A dataset of 2,675 annotated flame images was constructed, with the CA module integrated into the C3 module of YOLOv5. Experimental results reveal that the enhanced model achieves a remarkable balance between precision and recall, with the F1 score peaking at 0.67774 near a confidence threshold of 0.13. The model maintains stable performance within the 0.1 to 0.5 confidence range, providing flexibility for practical applications. At higher confidence levels, the model exhibits nearly perfect precision. The integration of the CA mechanism with YOLOv5 significantly boosts fire detection accuracy and efficiency, offering new insights for developing more reliable fire safety systems.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Assembly Sequence Planning for Array Antennas Based on a Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper presents research on a key technology in virtual assembly based on array antenna assemblies: assembly sequence planning. In evaluating assembly sequences, four factors are comprehensively considered: assembly feasibility, assembly redirection count, tool change count, and assembly stability. A fitness function is constructed for sequence evaluation. In terms of algorithm implementation, a hybrid intelligent algorithm combining differential evolution and simulated annealing is adopted to balance global and local search capabilities. MATLAB simulations are conducted to verify the proposed method, successfully identifying the optimal assembly sequence, and a comparative analysis of the hybrid algorithm’s convergence performance and optimization results is provided.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Arc Detection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The Arc fault features in low-voltage distribution network are not prominent, and multi feature set recognition is required. In this paper, a method of fault arc recognition based on deep neural network learning is proposed: based on convolutional neural network deep learning, the characteristics of nonlinear load, i.e. fault arc, are automatically recognized and extracted directly from the current waveform, and then the boundary conditions distinguishing normal load conditions from fault arc are established using artificial neural network, Select and optimize the AlexNet network architecture to build a deep learning based fault arc recognition model; Select the optimal parameter combination to implement the model training strategy. Finally, based on the constructed fault arc test platform with a computer RAM of 16.00GB and NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 graphics card, the operating data under various working conditions were sampled and analyzed using the above method. The analysis results accurately identified the occurrence of fault arcs, verifying the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Optimization of Material Supply Chain via Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The primary task of intelligent optimization of the entire supply chain is to address the bullwhip effect, and improving demand forecasting accuracy can effectively suppress the bullwhip effect. Building a model with high accuracy in demand forecasting for the material supply chain provides an important theoretical basis for enterprises to respond to market demand changes. With the significant advancements in machine learning technology, predictive analytics has gradually become a research hotspot. Improving the accuracy of forecasting helps to grasp future economic trends and consumer trends. This paper predicts the demand of the material supply chain based on deep learning methods, essentially a multivariate time series forecasting module. Firstly, the relevant data is processed through feature engineering, and a prediction model consisting of a CNN for extracting stationary features and an LSTM for analyzing time series is constructed. To verify the effectiveness of the model, this paper compares it with traditional machine learning algorithms and classical neural networks. The experiments demonstrate that the proposed method in this paper achieves good performance in demand forecasting for the material supply chain.

articleTitle: Procurement Budget Forecasting of Low-value Consumables in Colleges and Universities based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the procurement budget forecasting effect of low-value consumables in colleges and universities, this paper applies machine learning algorithm to the procurement budget process. This paper proposes a method of constructing the value index of low-value consumables combined with machine learning. Through the value index of low-value consumables, the due value of low-value consumables in the laboratory can be reflected, and then the low-value consumables with similar value range of low-value consumables value index can be clustered to form a systematic management object set, and the low-value consumables with larger value index can be managed in a targeted manner. Combined with the experimental research, it can be seen that the purchase budget forecasting model of low-value consumables in colleges and universities based on machine learning proposed in this paper has certain effects, and can optimize and improve the management system and system of laboratories in colleges and universities, so as to improve the level and quality of laboratory management in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Food Nutrition Optimization and Prediction System Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper therefore presents the use of an intelligent algorithm in developing a food nutrition optimization and prediction system where the system can collect nutrition data on food, constructs a nutrition prediction model, applies an optimization algorithm according to requirements in order to reach its nutritional needs. The use of a machine learning model of the system therefore makes it possible to accurately predict nutrients in the food formula. The experimental results show that the artificial neural network model performs well in capturing complex nutrient relationships and has a high prediction accuracy. Next, the genetic algorithm and particle swarm algorithm are used to optimize the food formula, successfully balancing the intake ratio of different nutrients and achieving specific optimization goals. The system has shown its effectiveness in multi-objective optimization tasks through experimental verification. It can adjust the food formula according to the input health needs and ensure that the nutrients meet the expected standards. This study shows that intelligent algorithms have significant application potential in the prediction and optimization of food nutrients, providing strong support for future personalized nutrition plans. Through the training and verification of the model and the performance evaluation of the optimization algorithm, the system has shown broad application prospects in the fields of nutrition and health management and the food industry.

articleTitle: Food Safety Traceability Technology and Application Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the blockchain traceability system, consumers mainly build trust in the system through system quality, and a good operating experience improves consumer efficiency and experience, thereby enhancing trust. In contrast, consumers build trust in suppliers through information quality, and the establishment of trust pays more attention to consumers' perception of their kindness, integrity and ability. This paper proposes a food safety traceability technology based on blockchain, and combines experimental analysis to verify the effectiveness of this technology. After the food safety supervision information management system based on blockchain technology is successfully constructed and initially deployed, it changes the centralized data management mode under the traditional mode and achieves good application results. At the same time, it promotes regulatory scientific and technological innovation and improves regulatory efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimization of Higher Vocational English Teaching Design Based on Optimizing Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the context of rapid advancement in information technology and the explosion of big data, the education sector is facing unprecedented opportunities to improve teaching effectiveness through data-driven approaches. The emergence of big data in education has paved the way for exploring new methods and extracting meaningful insights from vast amounts of teaching data. Analyzing assessment data in vocational English teaching using data mining and analysis techniques has become an urgent need to drive evidence-based improvements in teaching practices. This paper combines the advantages of the traditional Apriori algorithm and introduces the improved O-Apriori algorithm, which addresses the performance issue of full database scanning by adopting a data partitioning approach. The core of this algorithm lies in reducing the number of database scans and candidate sets and introducing a relevance value to address the problem of inaccurate association rules obtained by the original algorithm. It identifies the correlation between the evaluation of vocational English teaching quality and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) factors in teaching content and methods, thereby accurately pinpointing the key areas to enhance teaching quality. This enables teachers to make targeted adjustments to their content and provides robust data support for optimizing vocational English teaching design. The contribution of this paper lies in the development and application of the O-Apriori algorithm, which extracts actionable knowledge from assessment data in vocational English teaching, empowering educators to make data-based adjustments to their teaching methods. The findings of this research have the potential to have a significant impact on the future of vocational English education by providing a systematic and evidence-based approach to optimize teaching design and enhance overall teaching quality.

articleTitle: Social Security Event Prediction Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the construction and development of modern society, prediction, as an effective technology to evaluate the development trend and future state of things, can scientifically deal with the problems existing in traditional technical methods, and provide the basic guarantee for social economy and people’s security. At present, domestic and foreign scholars have put forward a number of forecasting methods in the comprehensive study, which are mainly divided into quantitative forecasting and qualitative forecasting. Although China has begun to pay attention to social risk forecasting in the past construction, the technical means mastered in practice cannot reach the level of developed countries under the influence of factors such as theoretical knowledge and technical level. Therefore, after understanding the current development status of social security event prediction in China, this paper mainly explores the application effect of credit risk prediction according to the machine learning model structure and social risk prediction method. The final experimental results prove that the construction of social risk prediction model based on machine learning algorithm can not only grasp more valuable data information, but also effectively prevent various events that endanger social security.

articleTitle: A Novel Five-Dimensional Chaotic System for Medical Image Encryption with X-Axis Projection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This manuscript introduces an encryption methodology for medical imagery, leveraging a novel five-dimensional chaotic system alongside projection techniques along the x-axis. We begin by constructing a pioneering five-dimensional chaotic system through sophisticated feedback control techniques. For the encryption process, the plaintext image's pixel values are utilized to set the radius, with the chaotic sequence dictating the angular relationship to the x-axis for the initial projection-based encryption. The encrypted medical image is then subjected to bit-level permutation based on the chaotic sequence, culminating in a bitwise XOR operation with the sequence to produce the final secure medical image. Comprehensive theoretical analysis and simulation data confirm the method's expansive key space, pronounced key sensitivity, and its adeptness at thwarting statistical and grayscale value analyses, marking it as a proficient encryption solution for medical images.

articleTitle: Demand Forecast of Cold Chain Logistics of Fresh Agricultural Products Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of fresh agricultural products market and the diversification of consumer demand, the operational efficiency of cold chain logistics and the accuracy of demand forecast have become the key to the development of the industry. Aiming at the limitations of traditional forecasting methods in dealing with complex nonlinear data relations, this paper proposes a hybrid model (CNN-LSTM) combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to forecast the demand of cold chain logistics. This model uses CNN's powerful feature extraction ability to capture local features of data and uses LSTM's time series processing ability to remember historical information to predict future demand. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional forecasting methods, CNN-LSTM hybrid model is more accurate in the overall trend forecasting, especially in the peak sales season and the product types with stable demand. However, in the off-season of sales and the product types with large fluctuations in demand, the prediction error increases slightly. The research in this paper provides new ideas and methods for the accurate prediction of cold chain logistics demand of fresh agricultural products, which is helpful to improve the operational efficiency and market responsiveness of cold chain logistics.

articleTitle: Stm32-based Home Environment Monitoring And Model Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: A stm32-based home environment monitoring system is designed, which can monitor temperature, humidity, co2 concentration and light intensity in the home, and also monitor data remotely and in real time via cell phone APP. In addition, the system has the ability to send data to the cloud through ESP8266 wifi module, store with mysql database, and display sensor data in real time in the upper computer, and also query historical data in the upper computer for callback display. We also incorporate emerging artificial intelligence techniques to feed the obtained data into a deep learning model to predict the data for the next seven days, so that one can move forward and take appropriate measures. Such systems allow users to respond to changes in their environment to make life more comfortable.

articleTitle: Big Data-Driven Financial Risk Management: Application of Association Rule Mining Technology in Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of the informatization process, corporate information management has received increasing attention. Facing the increasingly complex and volatile socio-economic environment, the difficulty of enterprise risk management has also grown progressively. Establishing an efficient risk management mechanism for corporate risk early-warning is the goal enterprises seek to achieve. Identifying useful information for financial risk early-warning management from the vast amount of financial data generated by business operations is an urgent issue that enterprises currently need to resolve. The continuous improvements and innovations in big data and data mining technologies, as well as their excellent performance in the analysis of massive datasets, have brought them closely together. Therefore, this paper uses data mining technology to study and analyze corporate financial risk early-warning and to conduct anomaly detection on financial risks, which has great theoretical and practical significance. This paper proposes a more efficient P-Apriori mining algorithm based on the parallel processing of frequent itemsets groupings. This algorithm first divides the frequent (k-1)-itemsets into groups using certain rules. After grouping, each set of frequent (k-1)-item subsets can not only be processed in parallel but can also significantly reduce the self-joining times of frequent (k-1)-itemsets. Then, by combining the frequent k-item subgroups produced by each group, the frequent k-itemsets can be obtained. This effectively reduces the time required to generate frequent itemsets and improves the efficiency of mining, providing technical support for further application research on financial risk analysis.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Physical Education Teaching Evaluation Mode Introducing Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Under the background of big data, with the rapid development of the Internet and the Internet of Things, more and more informatization is used in physical education, and the forms of physical education teaching information relying on the Internet are becoming increasingly diversified. In order to improve the evaluation effect of physical education teaching, the reverse cloud generator in one-dimensional cloud model is used to analyze the collected original data, and the digital characteristics of the cloud to which the evaluation indexes of teachers and students belong, and the specific algorithm of the reverse cloud generator is obtained. Through the method model proposed in this paper, remote autonomous physical education teaching and physical training methods can be realized, and effective identity recognition, privacy protection, sports data collection and sports injury prevention can be achieved. Combined with experimental research, it is verified that the evaluation model proposed in this paper has a user experience evaluation of above 85 points, the system experience effect is better, and the system evaluation results are more accurate.

articleTitle: A Study of Internet Users’ Heterogeneity Based on Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The emergence of big events is frequently followed by the existence of online public opinion, and netizens’ emotional comments heighten the hazards associated with the process of online public opinion transmission, resulting in social instability. Netizens’ emotionality is inextricably linked to their personality traits, and it is necessary to analyze their personalities in order to determine the corresponding public opinion countermeasures of government departments; thus, this paper conducts a study on netizen heterogeneity. A Graph Neural Network (GNN) personality prediction model is built on the Big Five personality model and the BERT model. The BERT model encodes the comment data and converts it into a graph neural network model; the dual attention mechanism extracts the relationship between the user and his/her diction, diction, and psychological keywords; the graph convolutional neural network extracts the features; and finally, the personality scores of the five dimensions of the Big Five personality model of Internet users are calculated. The study demonstrates that the graph neural network Internet user personality prediction model based on the BERT model has some advantages in the personality prediction task and can give data support for future Internet public opinion analysis.

articleTitle: A Study on the Rapid Classification of Medical Consumable Supply Chains Based on K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The application of the K-means clustering algorithm in the refined management of medical consumables within a pharmaceutical supply chain's big data framework, and constructs a classification model. Methods: The K-means clustering algorithm was applied to examine its use in classifying hospital consumables. Results: Based on outbound volume and frequency, K-means clustering quickly classifies consumables. Combined with management requirements, different inventory strategies can be implemented. Conclusion: K-means clustering in the pharmaceutical supply chain's big data enhances hospital management efficiency and optimizes costs. Customized strategies can be developed based on the characteristics of each consumable category, thereby strengthening the refined management of medical consumables in the hospital’s central warehouse.

articleTitle: Application of Artificial Intelligence and Decision Support System in Green Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This article aims to discuss the construction of AI application and decision support system (DSS) in green supply chain management (GSCM) and its influence on the sustainable development of enterprises. This article proposes a DSS based on artificial intelligence (AI) technology, aiming at improving the collaborative efficiency of supply chain (SC) through intelligent means. Methodologically, the decision support model is constructed by using random forest (RF) algorithm, and the superiority of the model in inventory turnover rate, response speed and comprehensive performance index is verified by experiments. The experimental results show that compared with traditional methods and other advanced models, the model proposed in this study can significantly improve the efficiency of GSCM and reduce the operating costs and environmental impact. DSS based on AI is an effective way to promote the sustainable development of enterprises and realize green transformation. In the future, with the progress of AI technology, the system is expected to bring more significant economic and environmental benefits to enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of Time Series Analysis in Predicting Industrial Data Security Events
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In today's industrial operations, the widespread application of digital technology has made industrial data security an increasingly important focus. Industrial data encompasses vital information in key areas such as production, manufacturing, and supply chains, making its security crucial for the stability of the entire operational system. However, with the rapid growth of industrial data, traditional security measures have proven to be inadequate. Therefore, this paper discusses how to use time series analysis to predict industrial data security incidents, thereby safeguarding the security of industrial data. Time series analysis, as an effective tool, can help identify patterns and trends in historical data, which can be utilized to forecast potential security incidents. This paper will demonstrate the effectiveness of time series analysis in the field of industrial data security and propose a security event prediction method based on historical data patterns. Through this research, we aim to provide more theoretical support and practical guidance for the field of industrial data security. This paper establishes a multi-scale temporal convolutional neural network for predicting industrial data security events. Firstly, in the temporal convolutional network, multi-scale modules are embedded, and two different-structured deep learning blocks are constructed. By changing the dilation factor in the dilated convolution, multi-scale modules are embedded to learn feature information at different scales and to integrate them, thereby achieving feature learning and prediction of industrial data security events at different scales. Secondly, residual connections are introduced to prevent overfitting and underfitting phenomena.

articleTitle: Design of Internet of Things-based Escalator Condition Monitoring and Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the development of China's economy and the rapid increase of the elderly population, escalators are becoming more and more popular in daily life, bringing a lot of convenience to travelling. At the same time in recent years, the frequent safety accidents of escalators have triggered people's concern, how to ensure the safe operation of escalators and at the same time diagnose and warn the faults in a timely manner, which has become the focus of many lift manufacturers and operation and maintenance personnel to study the problem. The traditional periodic inspection of escalators has caused a waste of manpower and material resources, and the increasingly large number of escalator types and quantities have made it inevitable to seek new inspection techniques and methods. The rapid development of the Internet of Things technology and sensor technology has brought a new development direction for the operational status monitoring of escalator parts. In this context, this paper constructs a status monitoring and early warning system for escalator parts (drive host, main drive shaft, step chain tensioning device, handrail belt).

articleTitle: Text Sentiment Classification Algorithm Based on BiLSTM Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In recent times, the swift evolution of mobile internet technology and the ubiquitous presence of diverse applications have made e-commerce and social media platforms integral to everyday life. These platforms offer a wide variety of products and services, facilitating user interactions through comment sections where consumers share their experiences. Typically, these comments are textual and rich in emotional expressions and personal perspectives. Accurate analysis of these emotional tendencies is crucial for platforms seeking to comprehend user requirements, refine service quality, elevate satisfaction levels, and execute targeted marketing strategies. To address this need, our study introduces a sentiment classification algorithm leveraging bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) and deep learning (DL) techniques. This algorithm captures the bidirectional context of text sequences using BiLSTM, enhancing the precision in identifying emotional cues. Experimental outcomes demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms traditional sentiment classification approaches, exhibiting notable gains in both accuracy and recall across various datasets.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recommendation System for Online English Teaching Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: According to the school's training plan and curriculum standards, formulating reasonable and personal English learning knowledge recommendations to students is an important research work at present. This paper proposes a group recommendation algorithm TAGR which combines time series and attention mechanism. In the model, GRU (gate current unit) is used to model the evolution of user interest with time, capture the transfer process of user interest from time series, and accurately represent user interest preferences through aggregation. At the same time, the attention mechanism is used to fuse group preferences, and the representative users in the group are strengthened by dynamic weighting, and the group preferences are modeled by using the interaction information between items and groups. The experimental results show that the proposed English teaching recommendation model is superior to the traditional model and improves the accuracy of group recommendation.

articleTitle: Design of an Immersive Experience Emotion Recognition and Analysis System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive research study on the emotional recognition algorithm for immersive experiences based on deep learning. In recent years, immersive technologies such as virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) have revolutionized the way people interact with digital content, creating highly engaging and interactive experiences. Understanding users’ emotions during these immersive experiences is becoming increasingly important for various applications, including entertainment, therapy, education, and training. However, accurately detecting emotions from actions in immersive environments remains a challenging task. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a deep learning-based emotional recognition algorithm specifically designed for immersive experiences. Aiming at the shortcoming of the convolutional neural network based on deep and shallow feature fusion in action emotion recognition without considering the temporal sequence of actions, a emotion recognition model based on CNN-BLSTM was designed. Firstly, the action structure features were extracted from the action data using the deep and shallow feature fusion-based action emotion recognition network, integrating features from different convolutional layers. Then, BLSTM extracted temporal dependencies from the fused features, combining CNN and BLSTM to achieve accurate recognition of action emotions. Finally, comparative experiments verified the superior recognition performance of the model on action emotions.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of Digital Talent Resource Allocation for Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Scientifically evaluating the allocation efficiency of digital talent resources for manufacturing is conducive to accelerating the manufacturing digital transformation, to promote breakthrough innovation. This paper constructs an efficiency system for the allocation of digital talent resources in the manufacturing from the input-output perspective. Taking Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China as the research object, the data envelopment analysis (DEA) method is used. Results show that, from the year 2012 to 2022, the efficiency of digital talent allocation is a staggered and continuous "W"-shaped growth trend and low pure technical efficiency is the main reason for the digital talents ineffective allocation. It also has certain deficiencies in input and output during the research period. The insufficient number of profitable high-tech manufacturing and the redundancy of budget investment in science and technology are the main factors. In view of this, it is suggested that, to highlight innovation, improve technological efficiency, focus on input-output ratio, and optimize the development environment of digital transformation to further optimize the allocation of digital talents and promote the digital transformation for manufacturing.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Sports Teaching Performance Evaluation Model Based on Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Different factors have great influence on students' physical education scores, and the existing evaluation methods have some problems such as confusion and inaccurate prediction. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a physical education teaching achievement evaluation model based on the decision tree algorithm, encompassing four key steps: data acquisition, feature selection, decision tree construction, and model evaluation. The C4.5 algorithm is employed to build and optimize the decision tree model. In the final evaluation stage, cross-validation and confusion matrix methods are utilized to assess the model's validity and reliability. Compared to traditional manual data processing methods, the use of the decision tree algorithm significantly enhances prediction accuracy. This evaluation model provides a valuable reference for assessing physical education teaching outcomes and guiding teaching improvements. Additionally, the model's decision rules facilitate the design and development of a curriculum grade prediction system, enabling teachers to monitor students' learning progress and predict course grades in real-time.

articleTitle: Design of Telemedicine System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This research conceptualizes a telemedicine framework that leverages the potential of Internet of Things technology to improve on the availability and effectiveness of health services at lower costs to patients and medical facilities. This paper presents the use of sensors and wearable devices in the collection of patient data in real-time by analyzing the structure of the Internet of Things, using the wireless communication technology in ensuring effective transmission. Massive data at the platform layer is smartly examined to offer users precise health management and decision-making assistance. The design of the system covers functional modules such as data collection, transmission, analysis and user interaction, and its effectiveness in the fields of chronic disease management, remote monitoring and postoperative care has been verified through application cases. Studies indicate that telemedicine solutions offer considerable benefits in enhancing the quality of life for patients and optimizing the distribution of healthcare resources. They are now a crucial factor in shaping contemporary healthcare models. The advancement of 5G network, along with artificial intelligence and big data technology, will enhance telemedicine systems' intelligence in disease prediction and personalized health management. These systems will integrate more deeply with smart homes and other city systems to enhance medical services. Seamlessly connect and extend to provide society with efficient and convenient health management solutions.

articleTitle: A New Rapid Evaluation System for Small Satellite Transportation Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of rapid analysis and evaluation of a large number of vibration data generated by the transportation environment during the group launch of small satellites, a new type of evaluation system for the transportation data of small satellites is constructed through the digital transformation of the existing data acquisition system, which can display, judge, warn, count, process and analyze the transportation acceleration environment of the satellite interface and key positions on the satellite in real time. At the same time, it can quickly process and statistically analyze the data of the whole transportation environment after the transportation process, and give the evaluation conclusion of the transportation environment, which provides data support and reference for the process optimization of the small satellite launch site.

articleTitle: Behavior Analysis and Safety Management of Workers in Limited Space Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the design of a limited space worker behavior analysis and safety management system based on machine learning. By using the methods of machine learning, behavior recognition, process monitoring and safety warning, an innovative behavior analysis and safety management system for workers in limited space is proposed. The system learns the operator's behavior through training model to realize the prediction and risk assessment of the operator's behavior. By using fault diagnosis and anomaly detection methods, we can realize early identification and warning of potentially dangerous behaviors by analyzing operators' operational data. The process monitoring system monitors the operation process of the operator in real time to ensure the safety of the operation. Finally, combined with human movement recognition technology, it provides an effective solution for the safety management of workers in limited space.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning Algorithm in Virtual Reality Interactive Product Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the design effect of virtual reality interactive products, this paper combines deep learning algorithms and intelligent interaction models to build a system model. In the design of interactive modes, this paper focuses on the design principles and technical implementation of gesture, speech and tactile feedback, and highlights the role of these interactive modes in enhancing user experience. In addition, the virtual environment design part, this paper focuses on scene simulation and role interaction. Finally, this paper provides a comprehensive and in-depth design framework for multimedia interactive system based on virtual reality technology. It covers all aspects from hardware selection to software implementation, from interactive technology to virtual environment design, and provides important guidance for the development of efficient and interactive virtual reality system, and also provides rich thinking and inspiration for future technological innovation and application expansion.

articleTitle: Financial Fraud Detection System Combining Generative Adversarial Networks and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In this research, we effectively merge generative adversarial networks (GAN) with deep learning methods and implement them in the area of financial fraud detection. After preprocessing and selecting features from public datasets, we developed a robust GAN model and trained the discriminator by combining real data with fake data generated by the generator. Research findings indicate that the deep learning model utilizing GAN outperforms traditional machine learning techniques in terms of detection accuracy, recall rate, and F1 score. Data enhancement with the GAN model produces fake data closely resembling real data, addressing issues with imbalanced financial fraud transaction data and enhancing the model’s detection capabilities and robustness. In addition, the model was comprehensively evaluated through various indicators such as ROC curve and confusion matrix in the experiment, which further verified the effectiveness and superiority of the GAN model. Overall, this study demonstrates the application value and superior performance of this method in financial fraud detection by building and training a GAN model, combined with data enhancement and experimental verification, and provides an effective solution for improving the security of financial transactions.

articleTitle: Research on Relative Orientation Method of Combined Panoramic Cylindrical Image
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: To overcome the problems of relative orientation of cylindrical panoramic images, the relative relationship is derived based on cylindrical projection in the first step. To resolve the relative orientation parameters, the optimization algorithm is then conducted based on the linear and nonlinear algorithms, respectively. Experiments on cylindrical panoramic images are quantity analyzed carefully, which show that the reprojection error can attain within one pixel.

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Analysis Model in Intelligent Logistics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The logistics big data in this paper mainly studies the optimization and prediction accuracy of logistics order quantity, helps logistics enterprises to arrange vehicle scheduling in advance, reduces the transportation cost of vehicles, and makes a series of generalizations about customer satisfaction evaluation methods in logistics service industry, and how to use convolutional neural network model to classify its text. It is very necessary to apply efficient and stable prediction algorithm to logistics order quantity prediction, which is also the core aspect of today's logistics enterprises. How to effectively use logistics big data to create more value for logistics enterprises is a concern of logistics enterprises. In this paper, the research and analysis of design and neural network in logistics, first of all, the research is an evaluation method of customer satisfaction in customer satisfaction, is an evaluation index of the logistics service industry, and then through the research and analysis of a large number of continuous BP neural network algorithm literature at home and abroad, combined with niche particle swarm, continue to optimize the parameters, and finally get the final results.

articleTitle: Digital Twin-Based Safety Monitoring and Evaluation System for the Datengxia Water Control Hub Project
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: One of the new requirements for smart water conservancy construction is to simulate virtual water scenes using digital twin technology. This article constructs a safety monitoring and evaluation system for the Datengxia Water Control Hub Project based on the digital twin project. By visualizing the modeling of engineering objects, models, schemes, and applications, a twin application that dynamically maps real business is established; The digital twin safety monitoring and evaluation system of the Datengxia Water Control Hub Project plays a certain role in promoting the safe and efficient management of water conservancy business in the digital twin project, with the aim of providing a model for China's digital twin project.

articleTitle: Elasticity Evaluation of Modern construction supply chain Based on Interval Intuitionistic Fuzzy Numbers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the operation efficiency of modern building supply chain, this paper combines interval intuitionistic fuzzy numbers to evaluate the flexibility of modern building supply chain. In order to accurately express the precise preference information of decision-makers for decision-making schemes, this paper uses interval form to better reflect the essential characteristics of the problem, and describes the essential attributes of the construction supply chain (CSC) in detail. Moreover, this paper constructs the general dynamic network model of CSC and the index system of robustness factors of CSC, and takes a construction company project as an example, organizes an expert evaluation team to evaluate the safety of CSC risks. The results show that the improved method proposed in this paper is feasible, and the evaluation results are in line with the actual situation, which solves the uncertainty problem of construction project SC risk evaluation well, broadens the application fields of interval intuitionistic fuzzy number, and provides a theoretical basis for the safety prevention of construction project supply chain.

articleTitle: Optimized LSTM Time Series Prediction Model for Industrial Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In industrial production, a large number of different data streams that gradually distribute with time bring adaptive challenges to industrial big data time series classification algorithms. Puts forward the multivariable tuning LSTM algorithm. This paper also explains the multivariable tuning LSTM algorithm from multiple angles, including the structure and module design of the algorithm and the tuning process of the algorithm. Compared with continuous data prediction algorithm, the experiment shows that the algorithm proposed in this paper can effectively improve the prediction accuracy. Moreover, the experiment verifies that the proposed algorithm model is more suitable for predicting industrial time series data to some extent, and the prediction ability of industrial time series data forecasting system formed by this prediction algorithm is further improved.

articleTitle: Design of Cloud-Based Supply Chain Management Platform for Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This study designs and implements a cloud-based supply chain management platform for manufacturing enterprises. The platform utilizes a multi-layered architecture with microservices and containerization, achieving high performance and scalability. Core functional modules include procurement, production, inventory, logistics, and sales management, integrating IoT, big data analytics, and artificial intelligence to provide intelligent solutions. Data security is ensured through multi-layered protection strategies to ensure compliance. Comprehensive testing confirms the system's reliability, stability, and security. Results demonstrate its capability to support large-scale concurrent access and extensive data processing while maintaining high performance and security. This research provides technical support and practical guidance for digital transformation and efficiency enhancement in manufacturing supply chain management.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IoT-Based Smart Home System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This paper elaborates on the design, implementation, and testing process of a smart home system based on the Internet of Things (IoT). The system adopts a three-tier architecture (perception layer, network layer, and application layer), integrating functionalities such as security monitoring, environmental control, and energy management. The implementation leverages open-source hardware and cloud platforms, ensuring flexibility and scalability. Testing covers aspects including functionality, performance, and security, with results showing excellent performance in key metrics such as functional completeness, concurrency handling, and network attack defense. Performance testing confirms stability and efficiency under normal and peak loads. Security testing validates reliability in network, data, and physical security. Despite minor optimization needs under extreme conditions, overall, the system demonstrates outstanding functionality, reliable performance, and robust security, providing a smart, efficient, and secure home solution for modern households. The design and implementation not only meet current smart home demands but also lay a solid foundation for future feature expansions and performance enhancements.

articleTitle: Resource Scheduling and Optimization Strategy in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Things (IoT), big data and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, edge computing, as a new computing model, is gradually becoming a key technology for processing massive data and realizing low latency services. Edge computing emerged as a cutting-edge computing paradigm. By pushing computing resources and data storage to the edge of the network, it greatly shortens the data processing path and provides an efficient solution for dealing with large-scale data processing and low latency requirements. In order to further improve the utilization efficiency of computing resources and optimize system performance indicators, the optimization of resource allocation and task scheduling in edge computing has become the focus of academic and industrial circles. This paper innovatively proposes a resource scheduling and optimization model based on edge computing, which deeply integrates AI algorithm to achieve dynamic optimal allocation of resources and intelligent scheduling of tasks. Through simulation experiments, it has been verified that the model not only significantly improves resource utilization and reduces task completion time, but also effectively responds to network fluctuations and load changes, demonstrating strong robustness and adaptability.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Automatic Mining Method of High-dimensional Text Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: How to obtain effective and valuable topic information from massive texts has always been a hot topic in text mining. This paper attempts to use the improved algorithm to model massive high-dimensional text data. On the premise of ensuring that the effect reduction of the model is controlled within the effective range, it greatly reduces the time required for the model to run, thus improving the problem of low computational efficiency of the original model when dealing with massive data. In order to solve the problem of improving the running efficiency of LSA algorithm, this paper puts forward an improved method. In addition, this paper proves through experiments that in a big data environment, the improved method greatly reduces the time required to run the LSA method without losing the accuracy of model classification, significantly improves the efficiency of modeling, and provides a theoretical reference for the subsequent automatic mining of high-dimensional text big data.

articleTitle: Personalized Tourism Route Planning System Combined with Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the effect of personalized tourist route planning of modern tourism, the optimization of tourist route is completed according to the characteristics of tourist route design and tourist information. In the past route optimization, the optimized route is not the optimal route, so this paper designs the system according to this situation. Moreover, this paper adopts the embedded structure design system hardware to locate the position of tourists in the scenic spot. In addition, this paper uses display module, GSM, GPS and microprocessor to form the hardware structure of automatic scheduling system of tourist route. The experimental results show that the model designed in this paper is better than the traditional model, so it can be applied to the planning and optimization of tourist routes in the future. The importance of IoT communication technology in personalized tourism recommendation has been verified through experimental analysis, which is also the direction for the development of smart tourism in the future. This study can provide reliable reference for personalized tourism in the future

articleTitle: Analysis of the Evolution of Police-Related Public Opinion Based on Multi-Source Online Public Opinion Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Police-Related Public Opinion, with its rapid spread and wide impact, has become a major challenge for public security work in the new era. In response, this paper conducts a study on the evolution mechanism of police-related public opinion based on multi-source online public opinion big data. First, the core concepts of police-related public opinion are outlined, clarifying the role of multiple actors and the stages of evolution. Then, positive information spreaders, negative information spreaders, and informers are introduced to construct the SPNIR model for the evolution of police-related public opinion. An empirical analysis was conducted using a local police-related case to verify the accuracy and effectiveness of the model. Finally, the study examines the impact of the intervention time and number of informers on the evolution of public opinion, finding that reasonable intervention strategies can effectively control the spread of negative information. This research provides a new theoretical framework and methodological support for an in-depth exploration of the evolution patterns of police-related public opinion.

articleTitle: Cold Chain Food Safety Detection Technology Combined with Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Whether the data can be analyzed and processed quickly and accurately and the risk level can be determined quickly and accurately has become the key to whether the cold chain food safety supervision department has good preventive ability, whether it can effectively prevent and respond to cold chain food safety problems in time, and intervene and control risks. This paper proposes a cold chain food safety detection technology combined with data mining technology, and proposes a food safety supervision model based on big data. Moreover, this paper combines Internet technology to enable the cold chain food safety information to be integrated in the data center, and then explores the potential laws through deeper data mining, which strengthens the needle-scratching of cold chain food temporary management and improves the early warning ability of cold chain food safety accidents.

articleTitle: Risk Identification Method for Power Customer Service Complaints Based on Artificial Intelligence Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The evaluation criteria for power customer service work are customer satisfaction evaluations, and improving customer evaluation scores is an important indicator of ensuring the quality of power supply services. Most customer demands that have not been satisfactorily resolved arise during the customer service process, and how to identify customer demands in customer service conversations is the key to solving this problem. The voice materials used in customer service are the basis for determining whether customer demands are met, but the efficiency of understanding large-scale voice materials through manual services is not high. The use of artificial intelligence language analysis models to batch mine customer demands in speech materials can significantly improve the efficiency of speech material analysis. Design a complaint phrase text matching model, using text matching algorithm to match the text in the speech material with the target text, and evaluate the speech material based on the matching coefficient to determine whether the customer meets the requirements of unresolved difficult demands. However, the text matching model calculates the customer’s complaint risk based on the similarity of text topics, and cannot accurately obtain evaluation results. On this basis, an attention model is introduced to superimpose the connection relationship and attention coefficient of keywords on the text matching results, and a comprehensive evaluation method is adopted to improve the prediction accuracy of customer complaint risk.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Core Data Management System for Large-scale Scientific Research Projects in Enterprises Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that traditional data management is difficult to be efficient, safe and scalable in large-scale scientific research projects, this paper puts forward a design scheme of data management system based on cloud computing, aiming at improving scientific research efficiency and optimizing costs. Based on AWS platform, the system covers four modules: data acquisition, storage, processing and analysis, and sharing. Apache Spark is used for efficient data processing, and AES encryption algorithm and role-based access control (RBAC) model are used to ensure data security. The system designed a clear data flow direction, from data collection to processing and analysis to sharing, and realized the automatic flow. After performance and security tests, the system is stable under high concurrency, with reasonable resource utilization and no obvious security loopholes. The successful design of this study provides an efficient, safe and extensible data management scheme for large-scale scientific research projects of enterprises.

articleTitle: The Application of Blockchain Technology in Hospital Information Management and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Medical data sharing is of great significance, but there are still problems such as sharing difficulties and privacy leakage. Aiming at these problems, this paper proposes a safe sharing model of medical data to realize the privacy protection and sharing of medical data. Furthermore, in order to enable medical institutions to reach a consensus safely and quickly and speed up the efficiency of data sharing, this paper proposes an improved consensus mechanism applied to the alliance blockchain, and finally realizes the safe and efficient sharing of medical data. In addition, this paper has carried on the performance test to the medical data sharing process of the system. Combined with experimental analysis, it can be seen that the hospital information management system combined with blockchain proposed in this paper has good results and can promote the construction progress of smart medical systems.

articleTitle: Object Detection: A Comprehensive Toolkit for Advanced Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Object detection is a critical research area in computer vision with applications ranging from autonomous driving to medical imaging. Despite significant advancements in the field, developing high-performance object detection systems remains a hard job to do because of how hard it is to training deep learning models and the need for extensive computational resources. PaddleDetection, a toolkit within PaddlePaddle, addresses these challenges by offering a comprehensive suite of pre-trained models, high-performance training and inference capabilities, and flexible APIs. This toolkit supports various popular architectures for example YOLO, SSD, and Faster R-CNN, enabling users to quickly prototype and deploy the best object detection systems. In addition, PaddleDetection includes tools for data augmentation, hyperparameter tuning, and performance evaluation, making it suitable for both academic and real life applications. This paper details the features and architecture of PaddleDetection, illustrates its effectiveness through benchmark comparisons, and showcases real-world applications across different domains.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Highway Transportation Service Quality Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The rapid advancement of transportation systems has led to an increased emphasis on evaluating and improving the quality of highway travel services. With the proliferation of big data technologies, there is a growing opportunity to leverage large-scale data analytics for comprehensive service quality assessment. This paper explores a novel methodology that integrates neural networks and genetic algorithms to evaluate highway travel service quality, addressing the complexities and challenges posed by the modern transportation landscape. In response to the shortcomings of random initialization of BP neural network parameters, this paper first proposes improvements to genetic algorithms from various perspectives. The enhanced genetic algorithm is then employed for optimizing the initial parameters of the BP network, followed by the training of the BP network to construct the final network used for evaluating the quality of public transportation services. The outcomes of this study are expected to drive advancements in transportation management strategies, fostering a more efficient, safe, and user-centric highway travel experience. The fusion of big data analytics, neural networks, and genetic algorithms opens avenues for continuous improvement and innovation in the realm of transportation services, ultimately benefiting both travelers and service providers alike.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Prediction Algorithms for Takeout Purchase Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In recent years, the food delivery industry has witnessed significant growth, with a rising number of individuals turning to online platforms for their meal orders. Understanding and predicting consumer purchasing behavior in this context is essential for businesses to enhance their services and optimize user satisfaction. This paper presents a study on data mining and prediction algorithms for food delivery purchasing behavior, utilizing deep learning methods. By leveraging deep learning techniques, we analyze user data to uncover patterns and trends in purchasing behavior. The primary aim is to develop accurate prediction models that can forecast future food delivery purchases with high precision. This work explores intelligent prediction of takeaway purchasing behavior through deep learning. Firstly, this paper introduces multi-head self-attention into the scenario of predicting takeaway purchasing behavior and models the dependency relationships between users' historical purchases using positional encoding. The paper utilizes the AUGRU structure to filter the evolutionary path of user interests, obtaining a more accurate representation of user interest vectors. Secondly, this work combines the aforementioned technologies to propose a user takeaway purchasing prediction network for recommendation of takeaway products. Thirdly, comprehensive experiments on the proposed method validate its correctness.

articleTitle: Data Security Algorithm for Public Decision Support System Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: It explores data security algorithms pertinent to public decision-making support systems using blockchain technology in solving core issues of the public decision-making process, such data security, openness, and efficiency. Based on the features of decentralization, tamper-proofing, and encryption of blockchain technology, a framework on data security for public decision support systems could be put forward, including data encryption, digital signature, verification, and implementation of smart contracts. Particular strategies for putting plans into action. By integrating public decision support systems demand analysis, this article develops a security algorithm design centered around blockchain. It demonstrates, through application scenarios and case studies, that this framework has considerable impact on enhancing data security, transparency, and decision-making efficiency. The findings of this study demonstrate the wide range of potential uses for blockchain technology in public management, enhancing data processing credibility and efficiency while meeting stringent security standards for decision-making support systems.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Algorithm to Ill-Conditioned Matrix Correction in RFM Location Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the application of intelligent algorithm to the ill-conditioned matrix correction in RFM (rotational feedback mechanism) positioning solution. By using intelligent algorithm, fault diagnosis, process monitoring and matrix optimization, an innovative RFM location solution system is proposed to improve the accuracy and reliability of location solution. Intelligent algorithm is used to learn the data in RFM positioning solution through training model, so as to realize the effective correction of ill-conditioned matrix and improve the positioning accuracy. By analyzing the data of RFM location solution, the fault diagnosis method is used to realize the early detection and diagnosis. Process monitoring operation data of RFM positioning solution to realize real-time monitoring of positioning solution process. Finally, the ill-conditioned matrix is corrected by using matrix optimization method, which provides an effective solution for RFM localization.

articleTitle: Financial Time Series Analysis and IPO Pricing Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This article studies machine learning based financial time series analysis and Initial Public Offering (IPO) pricing models, aiming to improve the accuracy of financial forecasting and the efficiency of IPO pricing through advanced machine learning techniques. Firstly, wavelet transform is used for data denoising, then a stacked autoencoder (SAE) is used to extract deep features, and finally a long short-term memory network (LSTM) is used to construct a prediction model. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional time series analysis method, this method shows better performance in dealing with nonlinear and high-noise financial data, and can predict financial indicators such as stock prices more accurately. In addition, the study also shows how to apply the machine learning model to the IPO pricing process, so as to comprehensively capture complex factors such as market dynamics and investor sentiment, thus improving the accuracy and efficiency of IPO pricing. These findings provide more effective decision-making tools for financial market participants, and provide new directions and ideas for future financial time series analysis and IPO pricing model research.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Internet of Things Tourism System in Tourism Attractiveness Evaluation and Application Effect Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to improve the application effect of intelligent Internet of Things tourism system in tourism attractiveness evaluation, this paper scientifically calculates the regional tourism attractiveness relationship matrix based on multi-source heterogeneous theory. Moreover, this paper comprehensively uses spatial analysis, social network theory, complex theory and other theoretical methods to comprehensively deconstruct the evolution characteristics of regional tourism attraction network structure, and reveals the changing law of tourism attraction and tourist flow tendency in multidimensional scale. In addition, this paper proposes a tourist comment mining method combined with Internet of Things tourism system, and establishes a data source platform for collecting data. Finally, this paper analyzes and processes the collected data, and then establishes a data warehouse, and uses the analyzed and processed data in practice to analyze the spatial and temporal distribution of tourism attraction, which provides a reference for the subsequent improvement of tourist destination.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Blockchain Consensus Mechanisms in Federated Learning for Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: Federated learning, as a distributed machine learning method is facing significant challenges in data privacy protection at present. This study aims to enhance the privacy protection capability of federated learning by integrating blockchain consensus mechanisms, as well as proposing a novel solution by designing a decentralized federated learning framework using consensus mechanisms such as Proof of Stake (PoS), and implementing smart contracts to automate key processes. The research results demonstrate that this approach effectively enhances the security and transparency of data processing while ensuring the efficiency and scalability of the system. Furthermore, the adoption of homomorphic encryption technology further ensures the security and integrity of data during transmission.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an AI-Driven Market Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This study explores the implementation, testing, and evaluation of an AI-driven market analysis system in detail. The system development employs advanced technical architecture, including distributed computing and deep learning frameworks. The intelligent data collection and preprocessing module enables efficient data acquisition and cleansing. The AI analysis engine integrates core functions such as market trend forecasting and customer behavior analysis. The visualization module provides an intuitive, interactive user interface. System testing covers multiple dimensions, including functionality, performance, and user experience, with results indicating that the system meets or exceeds expectations in data processing capability, analytical accuracy, and user-friendliness. The testing process not only validates the system’s reliability and efficiency but also provides valuable guidance for future optimization. Overall, the system demonstrates potential for providing accurate analysis and decision support in complex market environments, offering an innovative solution for the market analysis field.

articleTitle: Validity Verification of Encrypted Transaction Amounts in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: This research suggests an authentication system for encrypted payment amounts using zero-knowledge proof and encryption algorithm, with the goal of enhancing security and trustworthiness of blockchain transactions. The system effectively processes large-scale transaction data by incorporating functional modules like data input, verification, and output in a modular system architecture. Results from experiments demonstrate that the system achieves a verification precision of 99.8% when handling transaction data sets of various sizes, with processing time increasing proportionally as the transaction size grows, indicating excellent scalability. This research offers effective options for financial transactions, supply chain management, and digital asset management, guaranteeing the security and integrity of transactions while enhancing transparency and traceability in multi-party interactions. Furthermore, by examining various usage situations, the system showcases its wide range of potential and value in practical use. This research introduces fresh technological methods for verifying security in blockchain transactions and establishes a basis for future studies and implementation.

articleTitle: Knowledge Recommendation Model of Business English Teaching Based on Intelligent Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In order to ensure that the recommendation effect of business English teaching resources is targeted, a recommendation model of business English teaching resources is constructed, and an online teaching resource recommendation system for secondary vocational schools based on knowledge graph is designed and implemented, which can not only improve the accuracy and personalization level of resource recommendation, but also promote the effective use of educational resources. By mining students' behavior data and business English teaching resources data, this paper establishes a business English teaching resources recommendation model, and makes an empirical analysis. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the utilization efficiency of business English teaching resources and improve students' learning effect.

articleTitle: Hotel Intelligent Management System Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: In the global digital and intelligent environment, intelligent development has penetrated into all walks of life. The development of the hotel industry will undoubtedly follow the pace of intelligence and accelerate the development of intelligent and intelligent hotels. Therefore, the intelligent hotel management system designed and implemented by this topic has important value and significance in actual hotel project management. This paper proposes a hotel theme data algorithm, combines the Internet of Things and intelligent management systems to design an Internet of Things intelligent home system suitable for the hotel industry, and realizes the integrated design of a multi-functional interactive intelligent cloud system. These are the key development directions of hotel management system at present, and they are the academic focus and research value of this paper.

articleTitle: Optimization and Implementation of Intelligent Scheduling Algorithms in the Civil Aviation Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
abstract: The aviation industry faces increasingly complex scheduling challenges, necessitating intelligent solutions. To address this need, an intelligent scheduling system based on artificial intelligence has been designed and implemented. This system integrates deep learning and reinforcement learning algorithms to achieve intelligent scheduling of flights, crews, and slots. In actual operation, the system improved the on-time performance of flights from 76.3% to 89.5% and increased resource utilization by 23.7%. Economic benefit analysis shows that the system generates an annual benefit of 2.052 billion yuan, with a return on investment of 1610%. This achievement not only optimizes aviation operation management but also provides passengers with a better travel experience, significantly contributing to the intelligent development of the aviation industry.

articleTitle: Research on Algorithm for Detecting Weak Submarine Cable Magnetic Signal Based on SAAFSA-SR Combined with CSASVD
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Industrial IoT, Big Data and Supply Chain (IIoTBDSC)
